rv.q: To be sure, “We Are Proud to Present” is a bold way to begin Theatre Y’s tenure in North Lawndale.

Theater Y delivers with its current production of Jackie Sibblies Drury’s 2012 "We Are Proud to Present a Presentation About the Herero of Namibia, Formerly Known as South West Africa, From the German Sudwestafrika, Between the Years 1884-1915."
The heart of the piece is a tone-perfect summoning of the grief caused by the subjugation of one tribe by another.
